questionsToConsider: What are the minimum and maximum booking lengths you actually accept?
Which extras cost more, and should the form say so before people tick them?
Is there a group size above which you need to talk to the person before accepting?
How quickly can you promise a reply, so the ending can say it?
guide.howToUseResponses: Sort the requests by preferred date and check each against your calendar. When the first choice is taken and the person gave a backup, offer that before anything else, since they already said it works. Reply to anyone who said their date is fixed first, because they are the ones most likely to book somewhere else. Keep the extras column visible when you confirm so the setup matches what was asked for.
customizeSteps: Change the booking reasons and the time window on the two date questions to match your opening hours.
Replace the extras with the add-ons you really offer.
Put the link on your booking or contact page, or embed it next to your calendar.

faqs.q: What's the difference between a booking request and a booking?
faqs.a: A request asks for a date and waits for you to confirm it. It suits businesses that need to check availability, staff or setup before saying yes.

faqs.q: What should a booking request form ask?
faqs.a: The date and time, how long, how many people, any extras and a way to reach the person. A second-choice date saves the most time of all.

faqs.q: Can the form ask for a backup date only when it's useful?
faqs.a: Yes. This template asks whether the date is flexible and only then asks for a second choice.

faqs.q: Can I put a booking request form on my website?
faqs.a: Yes. Share it as a link or embed it on any page, and requests arrive in your dashboard as they come in.
